messages:
laura: Quick async standup — SLO/alerts/oncall follow-ups
laura: yesterday: rolled kv-evict debounce change to canary (10s -> 5s), added a grouping label fix, drafted the runbook PR (#412).
laura: blocker: starting ~18:10 we saw a burst of P2 pages during peak; looks like alerts re-fired after cache churn. not sure if debounce too short or grouping broke.
laura: today: 1) confirm root cause with alert logs 2) update alert rule + increase debounce 3) finish runbook CR — pinging oncall for handover.

mike: saw it — I got three P2s within 8m at 18:12-18:20. pushed an emergency change to alertdeck to increase debounce to 30s, but didn't ship rollback of the canary.
mike: quick note: alert rule had `group_by: [model, region]` removed by accident in the change, so grouping split into many pages.

mike: rolled alertdeck change at 18:25; pages stopped after ~18:28. didn't touch canary itself. :thumbsup:

laura: ah that explains it — grouping removal would amplify pages. thanks for the quickfix. can you paste the alert rule you patched?

mike: pasted below (sanitized):

```yaml
alert: HighTokenEgress
expr: sum(rate(token_egress_total[5m])) by (model, region) > 1000
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: P2
annotations:
  summary: "High token egress for {{ $labels.model }} in {{ $labels.region }}"
group_by: [model, region]
```

mike: we re-added `group_by` in the deck config and bumped debounce to 30s in the middle tier.

laura: nice. devon can you replay alert history for 18:00-19:00 and correlate with kv-evict logs? want to see if cache churn + minor model flaps caused extra token egress. @devon

devon: on it. spinning up a quick replay against archived metrics. ETA ~15m.
devon: preliminary: cache eviction spikes at 18:07 and 18:11, both preceded by small model rollout traffic spikes; matches the pages. sending correlating logs to the thread.

devon: suggestion: reintroduce a short soft-fail window in the runtime so tiny rollouts don't trigger full kv eviction. Also canary should be kept at 10% for an extra day.

laura: agree. I'll hold the canary rollback for now and modify runtime to add a 60s grace on eviction if requests < X/sec. adding to PR.

ashley: handover: I'm oncall from 19:00-03:00. if pages persist, escalate to infra oncall after 3 pages in 1h. runbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/kv-evict (draft).

ashley: note for oncall — how to rollback canary: `kubectl -n inference patch rollout kv-evict --patch '{"spec":{"canaryPercent":0}}'` (runbook has steps).

laura: thanks. I'll post a final update here after PR merge.

alertbot: [18:12] Alert fired: HighTokenEgress (model=all, region=us-east) — count: 3 — severity=P2
alertbot: [18:26] Alert cleared: HighTokenEgress — all resolved

mike: CR pinged for #412 — added reviewers: devon, ashley. pls review when you have a moment.

devon: review queued, will get it done during my cycle. one comment about test coverage for the grace window.

laura: wrapping: plan = keep canary, add grace window + grouping fix, wait 24h, if no recurrences drop to GA. Will update status in channel after 24h or earlier if we see more pages. :eyes:
